items.title: iPhone首度支援Apple Pencil！Duo讓Touch ID重返旗艦機
items.title_en: iPhone Supports Apple Pencil for the First Time! Duo Brings Touch ID Back to Flagship Models
paras: 蘋果首款摺疊智慧手機iPhone Duo 正式亮相，不僅採用可展開的大尺寸螢幕，更打破iPhone問世近20年來的產品慣例，首度支援Apple Pencil。蘋果也捨棄近年旗艦iPhone慣用的Face ID，改將Touch ID整合至側邊按鈕，讓指紋辨識重新回到高階iPhone。
iPhone Duo採書本式摺疊設計，機身閉合時可透過5.4吋外螢幕操作，展開後則提供7.6吋內螢幕。較大的顯示空間可同時開啟兩款App，或並排顯示同一款App的兩個視窗，讓使用方式更接近小型iPad。
蘋果過去一直未讓iPhone支援Apple Pencil，相關功能主要局限於iPad產品線。
隨著Duo展開後的螢幕面積增加，使用者未來可利用Apple Pencil手寫筆記、繪圖、標註文件，以及進行更精細的影像編輯，滿足果迷創作需求。
不過，Apple Pencil功能不會在iPhone Duo上市當日同步開放。
蘋果表示，相關支援預計於今年稍後透過軟體更新加入，因此首批購機用戶仍須等待後續版本，才能在Duo上體驗觸控筆操作。屆時Apple Pencil可在Duo的內、外兩面螢幕使用。
iPhone Duo對Apple Pencil的相容性也有限制，目前僅支援售價79美元的USB-C版Apple Pencil，無法搭配Apple Pencil Pro。
USB-C版具備傾斜感應功能，但不支援壓力感應、雙擊切換、側旋、觸覺回饋及尋找功能。
另一項重大改變是Touch ID回歸。
iPhone Duo未搭載Face ID，而是將指紋感測器整合至機身側邊按鈕，使用者握住手機時即可完成解鎖。
這項配置與部分iPad機型相似，也可避免在摺疊機的內、外兩面配置完整Face ID感測元件。
由於iPhone Duo可能處於閉合、展開或半摺疊狀態，將Touch ID設於側邊按鈕，可讓使用者無論操作哪一面螢幕，都能從同一位置完成身分驗證。
規格方面，iPhone Duo搭載A20 Pro晶片與蘋果自研C2數據機，最高提供2TB儲存空間，並配備兩顆4,800萬畫素後置鏡頭。
iPhone Duo 將於 10 月 16 日晚間 8 時開放預購，10 月 23 日正式上市，提供星光白與夜空色兩種配色。
paras_en: Apple’s first foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, was officially unveiled, featuring a large expandable display and breaking nearly 20 years of iPhone product tradition by supporting the Apple Pencil for the first time. Apple also abandons the Face ID system used on recent flagship iPhones, integrating Touch ID into the side button so fingerprint recognition returns to high‑end iPhones.

The iPhone Duo uses a book‑style folding design; when closed, a 5.4‑inch outer screen can be used, and when opened it reveals a 7.6‑inch inner screen. The larger display area allows two apps to run side‑by‑side or two windows of the same app to be shown simultaneously, making the experience closer to that of a small iPad.
Apple has previously never allowed the iPhone to support the Apple Pencil, with related functionality limited to the iPad product line.

With the increased screen area when the Duo is unfolded, users will be able to take handwritten notes, draw, annotate documents, and perform finer‑grained photo editing with the Apple Pencil, satisfying creators’ needs.
However, Apple Pencil functionality will not be available on the iPhone Duo on launch day.

Apple says the support is expected to arrive later this year via a software update, so the first batch of buyers will have to wait for a subsequent version before they can use a stylus on the Duo. At that time the Apple Pencil will work on both the inner and outer screens of the device.
Compatibility with the Apple Pencil on the iPhone Duo is also limited; currently only the $79 USB‑C version of the Apple Pencil is supported, and the Apple Pencil Pro is not compatible.
The USB‑C version includes tilt detection but does not support pressure sensitivity, double‑tap switching, rotation, haptic feedback, or the Find My feature.
Another major change is the return of Touch ID.
The iPhone Duo does not include Face ID; instead, the fingerprint sensor is integrated into the side button, allowing the phone to be unlocked simply by holding it.
This configuration is similar to some iPad models and also avoids the need to place full Face ID sensor arrays on both the inner and outer sides of a folding device.

Because the iPhone Duo may be in a closed, fully opened, or partially folded state, placing Touch ID on the side button lets users authenticate from the same location regardless of which screen they are using.
In terms of specifications, the iPhone Duo is powered by the A20 Pro chip and Apple’s in‑house C2 modem, offers up to 2 TB of storage, and is equipped with two 48‑megapixel rear cameras.
The iPhone Duo will open for pre‑orders at 8 p.m. on October 16 and launch on October 23, available in Starlight White and Night Sky colors.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉業績亮眼推升股價上揚 光聖、前鼎逆風強漲半根停板
items.title_en: Focus Stocks: Strong Earnings Lift Stock Prices; Guangsheng and Qian Ding Surge Against the Wind, Half‑Day Limit Up
paras: 台廠光通訊供應鏈受惠於AI資料中心光模組市場爆發，下半年訂單持續增溫，近期公告數據中，包括光聖(6442-TW)、前鼎(4908-TW)2家光通訊廠受惠業績亮眼，光聖昨(9)日公告8月營收，不僅年月雙增，更繳出單月歷史次高佳績，前鼎則自結7月獲利年增140％，激勵今(10)日股價雙雙開高走高，盤中價量齊揚攻上半根漲停板。
光聖公布8月營收達16.28億元，月增32.44％、年增152.24％，創公司歷史次高紀錄，今(2026)年1-8月累計合併營收達92.44億元，年增42.6％。
法人表示，光聖8月營收主要受光通訊市場持續強勁增加影響，今年持續受惠於美系市場大戶需求仍非常強勁，隨著AI應用推升光傳輸規格下，高傳輸光纖產品需求及出貨比重同步提升下，也持續挹注營運成長，除AI資料中心外，光聖也持續拓展RF及高頻連接器應用產品。
前鼎則自結今年7月單月獲利2,400萬元、年增140%、EPS為0.31元，前7月合併營收6.19億元、年增達28.19%，前鼎上半年稅後純益1.11億元、年增59.57%，EPS為1.42元，高於去年同期的0.89元。
前鼎則持續布局AI高速光通訊應用，公司指出，隨著CW雷射Chip on Carrier(CoC)產線在第3季底完成建置，也同步推進CPO 相關持續產品開發，隨著輝達(NVDA-US)採用CPO技術的矽光交換器正式邁入量產，將帶動光纖與關鍵零組件需求大爆發。
paras_en: Taiwan’s optical‑communication supply chain is benefiting from the explosion of AI data‑center optical modules, with orders warming up in the second half of the year. Recent disclosures show that two optical‑communication firms, Guangsheng (6442‑TW) and Qian Ding (4908‑TW), posted impressive results. Guangsheng announced its August revenue yesterday (Sept. 9), achieving double‑digit growth year‑over‑year and posting the second‑highest monthly figure in its history. Qian Ding reported a 140% year‑over‑year profit increase for July, prompting both stocks to open higher on Oct. 10 and climb to the half‑day limit‑up price with strong volume.

Guangsheng reported August revenue of NT$1.628 billion, up 32.44% month‑over‑month and 152.24% year‑over‑year, marking the second‑highest monthly record in the company’s history. For the year to date (Jan‑Aug 2026), consolidated revenue reached NT$9.244 billion, a 42.6% increase year‑over‑year.

Institutional investors said Guangsheng’s August revenue was mainly driven by the continued robust growth of the optical‑communication market. The company is still benefiting from strong demand from major U.S. customers, and as AI applications push higher optical‑transmission specifications, demand and shipment share for high‑capacity fiber products have risen, further fueling operating growth. In addition to AI data‑center business, Guangsheng is expanding into RF and high‑frequency connector applications.

Qian Ding posted a July profit of NT$24 million, a 140% year‑over‑year rise, with earnings per share (EPS) of NT$0.31. For the first seven months, consolidated revenue was NT$619 million, up 28.19% year‑over‑year. In the first half of the year, after‑tax net profit reached NT$111 million, a 59.57% increase, with EPS of NT$1.42, compared with NT$0.89 in the same period last year.

Qian Ding continues to position itself in AI‑high‑speed optical‑communication applications. The company noted that the CW laser Chip‑on‑Carrier (CoC) production line will be completed by the end of Q3, and it is simultaneously advancing CPO‑related product development. With NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) adopting CPO technology for silicon‑photonic switches now entering mass production, demand for optical fibers and key components is expected to explode.

items.title: 惠譽看台灣：證券業上半年獲利狂飆325% 但大小券商結構差距恐擴大
items.title_en: Fitch Views Taiwan: Securities Industry Profit Soars 325% in H1 but Gap Between Large and Small Brokers May Widen
paras: 惠譽信評今（10）日發布最新評估指出，台灣證券業2026年上半年表現極為強勁，整體行業淨利年增325%，年化股東權益報酬率從2025年的14.6%暴升至34.1%。雖然近期市場波動加劇，但在強勁獲利支撐下，下半年獲利韌性仍可維持。然而，亮眼數據背後反映出大小型券商差距持續擴大，小型券商結構性脆弱性升高，若市場環境反轉，營運弱點將更加浮現。
受益於熱絡的市場活動，2026年上半年自營、經紀與承銷收入全面成長。全市場日均成交量創下390億美元歷史新高，較2025年水準增加133%；融資餘額升至250億美元，增幅達73%。大型券商憑藉集團綜效、數位平台及旗下投信擴大的ETF產品線，順利吸納機構資金與散戶轉向ETF的趨勢，市場地位持續鞏固；相較之下，小型券商業務多元化不足，過度依賴自營收入且經紀市佔率持續流失。
資產負債表方面，前十大券商調整後淨槓桿倍數由2025年底的7.4倍升至9.6倍，主因交割資產增加93%、高度擔保放款曝險增加52%，以及台股上半年大漲59%帶動投資部位評價利益增加20%。惠譽認為槓桿上升不代表風險等比例增加，由於交割應收款存續期短，且放款有充分擔保與嚴格風控，7月及8月市場修正期間已有效控制信用損失。
展望後市，惠譽預期多數券商受惠於保留盈餘與資產負債表管理，即使槓桿上升仍能維持適切的資本緩衝與流動性。若市場活動降溫，槓桿水準亦可能隨之回落。大型券商風險管理政策執行較佳，能承受市場衝擊；小型券商若缺乏多角化布局，在市場反轉時營運風險依然較高。
paras_en: Fitch Ratings released its latest assessment today (the 10th), noting that Taiwan’s securities industry showed extremely strong performance in the first half of 2026, with overall industry net profit up 325% year‑over‑year and the annualized return on equity jumping from 14.6% in 2025 to 34.1%. Although recent market volatility has intensified, the robust earnings base should keep profit resilience intact for the second half. Behind the impressive figures, however, the gap between large and small brokers continues to widen, raising structural fragility for smaller firms; a market reversal would likely expose their operational weaknesses more sharply.

Benefiting from lively market activity, proprietary trading, brokerage and underwriting revenues all grew in the first half of 2026. The market’s average daily turnover hit a historic high of US$39 billion, 133% higher than the 2025 level, while margin balances rose to US$25 billion, a 73% increase. Large brokers leveraged group synergies, digital platforms and expanded ETF product lines from their asset‑management arms to attract institutional capital and retail investors shifting to ETFs, further solidifying their market position. In contrast, smaller brokers lack diversification, rely heavily on proprietary trading income, and are losing brokerage market share.

On the balance‑sheet side, the adjusted net leverage ratio of the top ten brokers rose from 7.4× at the end of 2025 to 9.6×, driven mainly by a 93% increase in settlement assets, a 52% rise in highly‑collateralised loan exposure, and a 59% surge in the Taiwan stock index in the first half that boosted valuation gains on investment positions by 20%. Fitch believes the higher leverage does not translate into proportionally higher risk because settlement receivables have short maturities and the loans are well‑collateralised with strict risk controls; credit losses were effectively contained during the market correction in July and August.

Looking ahead, Fitch expects most brokers to benefit from retained earnings and balance‑sheet management, allowing them to maintain adequate capital buffers and liquidity despite higher leverage. Should market activity cool, leverage levels may also retreat. Large brokers, with stronger risk‑management policies, are better positioned to absorb market shocks, whereas smaller brokers lacking diversified business models would face higher operational risk if the market turns.

items.title: CBS News：美軍一架A-10機翼斷裂、8架F-15戰機受損
items.title_en: CBS News: US A-10 Wing Breaks, Eight F-15s Damaged
paras: 據美國媒體9日（周三）報導，多架美國軍機在伊朗8日對約旦穆沃費格薩勒提空軍基地的襲擊中受損。
據美國《CBS News》報導，消息人士透露，一架A-10「雷電」攻擊機被擊中，一側機翼斷裂。另有8架F-15戰機輕微受損，現已重新投入使用。
伊朗襲擊發生在美軍8日打擊5艘伊朗油輪後。駐約旦美軍發射了30多枚「愛國者」防空飛彈，防禦伊朗襲擊。
據伊朗媒體報導，作為伊朗油輪遭襲的回應，伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊打擊了位於約旦的美軍基地，目標包括敵方戰機部署區，以及F-35、F-16和F-15戰機掩體。
paras_en: According to U.S. media reports on Wednesday the 9th, several U.S. military aircraft were damaged during Iran’s attack on the Jordanian Muwaffaq Salti Air Base on the 8th.
CBS News reported that sources said an A‑10 “Thunderbolt” attack aircraft was hit and one wing broke off. Eight F‑15 fighters sustained minor damage and have since been returned to service.

The Iranian attack occurred after U.S. forces struck five Iranian oil tankers on the 8th. U.S. forces stationed in Jordan fired more than 30 Patriot air‑defence missiles to counter the Iranian strike.

Iranian media reported that in response to the attack on its oil tankers, the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps struck the U.S. base in Jordan, targeting enemy aircraft deployment areas and the shelters for F‑35, F‑16 and F‑15 fighters.

items.title: 「新債王」岡拉克：Fed若不升息 長天期美債恐再遭拋售
items.title_en: "New Bond King" Jeffrey Gundlach: If the Fed Holds Rates, Long‑Term Treasuries May Face Another Sell‑Off
paras: 有「新債王」之稱的DoubleLine Capital執行長岡拉克(Jeffrey Gundlach)周二(8日)在網路直播中示警：如果聯準會(Fed)在下周的政策會議上違背市場預期、選擇維持利率不變，長期美債殖利率可能進一步攀升，從而加劇這場歷史性的債券市場拋售。
岡拉克表示，市場定價暗示聯準會下周升息25個基點的機率約為60%，但他個人「傾向於」認為決策者最終不會採取行動。
他指出，儘管美國通膨仍然頑固、經濟活動指標強勁，他仍質疑聯準會是否有意願恢復緊縮政策。
岡拉克以對市場的前瞻性判斷著稱，曾多次預警美股估值偏高、私募信貸市場風險，並建議投資人配置黃金等實物資產。他的公開談話和網路直播受到全球固定收益投資人的密切關注，被視為債券市場的重要風向標。
政策利率與短端殖利率再度「脫節」
岡拉克特別強調聯邦基金利率與2年期美債殖利率之間的顯著差距。周二，有效聯邦基金利率為3.63%，而美國2年期國債殖利率已攀升至4.998%，兩者利差約為137個基點。
他表示，「基於2年期美債殖利率的交易水平，聯邦基金利率可能應該比當前高出約50個基點。」並指出儘管當前的錯位程度不及2022年嚴重，但政策利率與殖利率曲線短端再次出現「脫節」。
這項差距反映了市場的核心擔憂：投資人普遍認為聯準會當前的政策立場不足以遏制通膨，短期利率需要在未來兩年內保持高位，甚至進一步走高。
30年期美債的結構性脆弱
岡拉克認為，美國30年期國債仍存在結構性脆弱。自2020年低點以來，30年期殖利率經歷大規模重新定價，周二達到約5.25%，累計漲幅接近500個基點。此劇烈變動已導致長期美債出現「超過50%」的帳面虧損。
更令這位債市老將警惕的是，在殖利率如此劇烈上升之後，債券市場仍未能出現有意義的反彈。
「當殖利率已累計上行近500個基點，而市場仍無法反彈時，這通常意味著下一階段將是現有上行趨勢的延續。」岡拉克表示，並重申此前的觀點：投資人應避開「所有已開發經濟體」的長期政府債券。
他補充，雙線資本的某些基金仍持有30年期美債的單邊空頭部位，這策略近年來「表現相當不錯」。
10年期美債殖利率一直在2023年10月以來的最高水平附近交易，而最新一波拋售已將30年期殖利率推升至2007年以來的最高水平。
巨額供給壓力推高期限溢價
岡拉克將當前債券拋售歸因於多重因素，包括美國國債大量發行、企業融資需求激增，尤其是AI相關公司的債務發行，以及持續的財政赤字壓力。他認為市場「正艱難消化如此龐大的債券供給」。
他警告，結構性走高的實質殖利率、持續的通膨壓力以及巨額財政赤字，意味著期限溢價將在較長時期內保持高位。期限溢價是指投資人持有長期債券所要求的額外補償；若持續高企，意味著長端殖利率更可能上升，而非下降。
在此背景下，岡拉克明確表達了他的資產配置偏好：相較於長期美國國債，他更青睞久期較短的固定收益資產、本幣計價的新興市場債券以及實物資產。他預計，如果聯準會再次落後於通膨曲線，長期美債可能進一步走弱。
Fed決策前的關鍵數據
下周的聯準會政策會議正值市場分歧顯著之際。上周五的非農就業報告遠超預期，提振了9月升息的機率，但聯準會是否會真正恢復緊縮政策，仍存在相當大的不確定性。
作為這周投資人最大關注焦點之一，美國8月消費者物價指數(CPI)報告將於周五發布，將為聯準會下周決策提供關鍵參考。
根據CME FedWatch工具，市場目前定價聯準會9月維持利率不變的機率為40.6%，累計升息25個基點的機率為59.4%。
岡拉克的警告正值債券市場處於關鍵十字路口。如果聯準會選擇按兵不動，市場可能將其解讀為決策者在通膨壓力面前猶豫不決，從而可能推動長端殖利率突破既有區間。
反之，如果聯準會如部分市場參與者預期的那樣恢復升息，債券市場可能在當前水平附近獲得一定喘息。
無論如何，下周的聯準會決策和周五的CPI數據，都將成為決定美債市場近期方向的關鍵催化劑。
paras_en: Jeffrey Gundlach, the so‑called "New Bond King" and CEO of DoubleLine Capital, warned on Tuesday (the 8th) during a live online broadcast that if the Federal Reserve defies market expectations at next week’s policy meeting and chooses to keep rates unchanged, long‑term U.S. Treasury yields could rise further, intensifying this historic bond market sell‑off.

Gundlach said the market pricing implies about a 60% chance that the Fed will raise rates by 25 basis points next week, but he personally "leans toward" the view that policymakers will ultimately not act.
He pointed out that despite stubborn U.S. inflation and strong economic activity indicators, he still questions whether the Fed is willing to resume a tightening stance.

Gundlach is known for his forward‑looking market judgments, having repeatedly warned of overvalued U.S. equities, risks in the private‑credit market, and advised investors to allocate to physical assets such as gold. His public talks and live streams are closely watched by global fixed‑income investors and are seen as a key barometer for the bond market.
Policy rates and short‑end yields are once again "disconnected".

Gundlach specifically highlighted the significant gap between the federal funds rate and the 2‑year Treasury yield. On Tuesday, the effective federal funds rate was 3.63%, while the U.S. 2‑year Treasury yield had risen to 4.998%, a spread of about 137 basis points.

He stated that "based on the trading level of the 2‑year Treasury yield, the federal funds rate should be about 50 basis points higher than it is now," and noted that although the current misalignment is not as severe as in 2022, policy rates and the short end of the yield curve have again become "disconnected".

This gap reflects the market’s core concern: investors generally believe the Fed’s current stance is insufficient to curb inflation, and short‑term rates need to remain high for the next two years, possibly rising further.
Structural vulnerability of the 30‑year Treasury

Gundlach believes the U.S. 30‑year Treasury still has structural vulnerability. Since the low in 2020, the 30‑year yield has undergone a massive repricing, reaching about 5.25% on Tuesday, a cumulative rise of nearly 500 basis points. This sharp change has caused long‑term Treasuries to record book losses exceeding 50%.
What further alarms this bond‑market veteran is that after such a sharp rise in yields, the bond market has not yet shown a meaningful rebound.

"When yields have risen cumulatively by almost 500 basis points and the market still cannot rebound, it usually means the next phase will be a continuation of the existing upward trend," Gundlach said, reiterating his earlier view that investors should avoid "all long‑term government bonds in developed economies."
He added that some of DoubleLine’s funds still hold unilateral short positions on 30‑year Treasuries, a strategy that has performed "quite well" in recent years.
The 10‑year Treasury yield has been trading near its highest level since October 2023, and the latest sell‑off has pushed the 30‑year yield to its highest level since 2007.
Large supply pressure pushes up the term premium

Gundlach attributes the current bond sell‑off to multiple factors, including large U.S. Treasury issuances, a surge in corporate financing demand—especially debt issuances by AI‑related companies—and ongoing fiscal‑deficit pressure. He believes the market is "struggling to digest such a massive supply of bonds."

He warned that structurally higher real yields, persistent inflationary pressure, and massive fiscal deficits mean the term premium will remain high for a long period. The term premium is the additional compensation investors require to hold long‑term bonds; if it stays high, long‑end yields are more likely to rise rather than fall.

Against this backdrop, Gundlach made his asset‑allocation preference clear: compared to long‑term U.S. Treasuries, he favors shorter‑duration fixed‑income assets, home‑currency‑denominated emerging‑market bonds, and physical assets. He expects that if the Fed again lags behind the inflation curve, long‑term Treasuries may weaken further.
Key data before the Fed decision

Next week’s Fed policy meeting comes at a time of significant market division. The non‑farm payroll report from last Friday far exceeded expectations, boosting the odds of a September rate hike, but whether the Fed will truly resume tightening remains highly uncertain.
One of the biggest investor concerns this week is the U.S. August CPI report, due on Friday, which will provide a key reference for next week’s Fed decision.
According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market currently prices a 40.6% chance that the Fed will keep rates unchanged in September, and a 59.4% chance of a 25‑basis‑point hike.

Gundlach’s warning comes at a critical crossroads for the bond market. If the Fed chooses to stand pat, the market may interpret this as indecision in the face of inflationary pressure, potentially driving long‑end yields to break out of their existing range.
Conversely, if the Fed resumes hikes as some market participants expect, the bond market may gain some breathing room at current levels.
Regardless, next week’s Fed decision and Friday’s CPI data will be the key catalysts determining the short‑term direction of the U.S. Treasury market.

items.title: 人類史上首次！全球老人比小孩多了
items.title_en: First Time in Human History! More Elderly Than Children Worldwide
paras: 美國政府機關與澳洲學術人員的最新聯合報告顯示，截至2025年全球65歲及以上人口約‌8.52億‌，佔‌10.5%‌，5歲以下兒童佔不到10%，這是有紀錄以來前者數量首次超過後者。
關於老年人的年齡定義，更早進入老年化的發達國家，普遍採用65歲劃分線，而開發中國家多採用60歲的標準；5歲以下則是兒童群體中年齡最小的組成部分，用於精準分析低齡人口的規模、結構和變動趨勢。
美國人口普查局表示，隨著「嬰兒潮」一代當中最年輕成員步入65歲前後，這種轉變的規模和速度日益凸顯。「嬰兒潮」概念最早來源於美國，是指二戰之後集中出生的大規模人口世代，不同國家的劃分時間範圍存在差異‌。
目前全球超過71%人口生活在總和生育率處於或低於更替水準（每名女性大約生育2.1個孩子）的國家，10年前僅45%。世界到達這一臨界點的時間比人口學家十年前預期的要早得多。
這一趨勢將在未來幾十年持續加劇。到2060年全球65歲及以上人口預估將從2025年的8.52億增至20億，佔19.6%。屆時亞洲65歲及以上人口將佔全球新增老年人口三分之二，形勢最為嚴峻。
老齡化程度快速提高，是生育率降低，以及人均壽命延長等社會變革綜合影響的必然結果。預期壽命延長是社會進步的核心標誌性體現之一，但對於政策制定者來說，這意味長期公共服務財政預算面臨更大壓力。
該報告提醒，面對這一人口結構逆轉，各國政府和全社會必須儘早適應，尤其是意識到壽命延長的積極作用，不應再視其為負擔，而是看作寶貴資產。許多經驗豐富、精力允許的老年人也願意繼續工作，填補勞動力短缺。
paras_en: A latest joint report by U.S. government agencies and Australian academics shows that by 2025 the global population aged 65 and over will be about 852 million, accounting for 10.5% of the world, while children under five will make up less than 10%. This is the first time on record that the former outnumbers the latter.

Regarding the definition of old age, more advanced economies that entered aging earlier generally use 65 as the cutoff, whereas many developing countries adopt a 60‑year threshold; children under five represent the youngest segment of the child population and are used for precise analysis of the size, structure and trends of the youngest cohorts.

The U.S. Census Bureau notes that as the youngest members of the “baby‑boom” generation reach around age 65, the scale and speed of this shift become increasingly evident. The “baby‑boom” concept originated in the United States and refers to the large cohort born after World War II, though the exact birth years vary by country.

Currently more than 71% of the world’s population lives in countries where the total fertility rate is at or below replacement level (about 2.1 children per woman), up from just 45% a decade ago. The world reached this tipping point much earlier than demographers had predicted ten years ago.

The trend will intensify over the coming decades. By 2060 the global 65‑plus population is projected to rise from 852 million in 2025 to 2 billion, or 19.6% of humanity. At that point, Asia will account for two‑thirds of the increase in the world’s elderly population, making the situation most acute there.

The rapid rise in aging is an inevitable outcome of lower fertility and longer life expectancy, among other social changes. Longer lifespans are a hallmark of societal progress, but for policymakers they also mean greater long‑term pressure on public‑service fiscal budgets.

The report warns that, faced with this demographic reversal, governments and societies must adapt early, recognizing the positive impact of longer lives rather than viewing them as a burden. Many experienced, capable seniors are willing to keep working, helping to alleviate labor shortages.

items.title: 瘋狂買！高盛6天砸26.6億美元連收NEOS、LCN 狂攻ETF、房地產 與另類投資
items.title_en: Crazy Buying! Goldman Sachs Dumps $2.66 Billion in Six Days, Acquiring NEOS, LCN, and Launching a Blitz on ETFs, Real Estate, and Alternative Investments
paras: 高盛集團 (GS-US) 近期密集擴張資產與財富管理版圖，短短6天內先後宣布收購ETF業者NEOS Investments及商業房地產投資公司LCN Capital Partners，最高交易對價合計約26.6億美元。兩筆交易分別切入選擇權策略ETF與商業不動產售後回租市場，凸顯高盛正持續把資本與資源投入相對穩定、可產生經常性管理費收入的業務。
高盛8月12日宣布，將以最高22.5億美元現金及股票收購NEOS Investments。NEOS成立於2022年，目前管理約300億美元資產，旗下有19檔以選擇權策略為核心的收益型ETF，產品主要透過衍生品提高收益、管理下行風險並提供每月收益。
這筆交易預計在2027年第1季完成，交易對價最高22.5億美元，實際金額取決於NEOS未來達成特定業績及服務承諾。交易完成後，NEOS共同創辦人Troy Cates及Garrett Paolella將加入高盛資產管理部門擔任合夥人，NEOS整個團隊也預計加入高盛。
高盛表示，NEOS與既有業務具有高度互補性。高盛目前已透過Innovator Capital Management布局以選擇權為基礎的ETF策略，今年4月完成對Innovator的收購，交易對價約20億美元。隨著NEOS加入，兩筆收購將與高盛既有ETF平台形成更完整的選擇權策略ETF業務。
高盛指出，截至2026年6月30日，公司、Innovator及NEOS合計管理超過1300億美元ETF資產，其中NEOS本身管理300億美元。交易完成後，高盛主動型ETF資產規模預計達到800億美元，並成為全球第8大主動型ETF管理業者。
NEOS所處的市場也正快速成長。高盛援引Morningstar資料指出，全球衍生品收益型ETF目前管理資產約1800億美元，自2021年以來年複合成長率超過70%，是ETF市場成長最快的類別之一。投資人對收益、稅務效率及下行風險管理的需求增加，正推動這類產品快速擴張。
就在宣布收購NEOS約6天後，高盛8月18日再宣布以最高4.1億美元收購商業房地產投資公司LCN Capital Partners，其中約2.6億美元將在交易完成時支付，另有最高1.5億美元與未來業績及服務承諾掛鉤。約80%的交易對價將以高盛股票支付，交易預計在2026年底完成。
LCN Capital成立於2011年，管理資產約30億美元，主要專注於售後回租及三淨租賃策略。這類交易通常由企業出售自有不動產後再租回使用，企業可以釋放房地產所占用的資本，而投資人則取得相對穩定的租金收入。
高盛收購LCN後，LCN共同創辦人Edward V. LaPuma及Bryan York Colwell以及旗下團隊將加入高盛資產管理部門的房地產平台。高盛認為，此次收購將擴大公司服務機構投資人、保險公司及財富管理客戶的能力，並進一步切入售後回租市場。
如果將這兩筆交易放在一起觀察，可以看到高盛資產管理策略的共同方向：一方面透過NEOS及Innovator擴大主動型ETF及選擇權策略產品，另一方面透過LCN擴大房地產及另類投資能力，藉此增加產品種類並擴大可收取管理費及相關費用的資產基礎。
這項策略也與高盛近年的業務轉型方向一致。相較於投資銀行、股票交易及固定收益交易等容易受到市場景氣影響的業務，資產與財富管理可以透過管理費、顧問費及其他相關收入建立較穩定的經常性營收來源。
高盛2026年第二季資產與財富管理部門淨營收達45.97億美元，較去年同期的約38.3億美元成長20%，較今年第1季的約40.7億美元增加13%。其中管理與其他費用收入達33.55億美元，創下紀錄，反映資產規模擴大已開始轉化為更高的經常性收入。
截至6月底，高盛資產與財富管理部門的資產監管規模(AUS)達4.041兆美元，較第1季的3.65兆美元增加3910億美元，也較2025年第二季的3.293兆美元增加7480億美元。這是高盛AUS首次突破4兆美元大關。
其中，另類投資AUS達4590億美元，高於第1季的4290億美元及去年同期的3710億美元；股票資產為1.123兆美元，固定收益資產為1.394兆美元，流動性產品則為1.065兆美元。
第二季高盛長期資產淨流入達910億美元，其中第三方分銷客戶渠道流入560億美元、財富管理客戶流入190億美元、機構客戶流入160億美元；包括流動性產品在內的總資產淨流入則達2300億美元，另有1610億美元來自市場升值。
另類投資也是高盛近年積極擴張的核心領域。第二季另類投資AUS單季增加300億美元，第三方另類投資募資更創下590億美元的單季紀錄。高盛簡報顯示，另類投資管理與其他費用收入第二季達7.25億美元，較去年同期成長22%。
高盛整體第二季業績同樣強勁。公司第二季淨營收達203.38億美元，淨利為66.28億美元，稀釋後每股盈餘(EPS)為20.98美元，年化股東權益報酬率(ROE)為23.5%。資產與財富管理業務的強勁表現，正成為整體業績的重要支柱。
高盛的策略並非只在於單純擴大資產管理規模，而是試圖建立從機構投資到高淨值客戶的完整產品生態。透過ETF、另類投資、私人市場、房地產及財富管理服務，公司可以將原本較複雜、過去主要由大型機構使用的投資策略，轉化為更容易銷售給高淨值個人及財富管理客戶的產品。
其中，私人市場尤其具有吸引力。高盛近年持續擴大私人股權、私人信貸、基礎建設及房地產等另類投資產品，並透過資產管理平台把機構級投資機會帶給更廣泛的財富管理客戶。
這種模式也能提高高盛與高淨值客戶之間的黏著度。當客戶同時使用ETF、另類投資、私人市場及財富管理服務時，高盛不僅能取得交易相關收入，也能透過管理費及其他服務建立較長期的收入來源。
從產業環境來看，資產管理業者目前也正面臨ETF快速成長、被動投資競爭及費率下降等壓力，因此大型金融機構開始積極收購具特色的ETF業者，以取得差異化產品及分銷能力。高盛接連收購Innovator與NEOS，正是這波產業整合的一部分。
同時，LCN交易則代表高盛並未把資產管理擴張限制在公開市場產品，而是同步向商業房地產及其他另類資產延伸。售後回租等策略能夠提供與通膨及實體資產相關的收益來源，也有助於高盛為機構與財富管理客戶提供更多元的資產配置工具。
因此，兩筆交易雖然分屬ETF與商業房地產，看似毫不相關，但背後其實指向同一項戰略：擴大高盛資產與財富管理平台的產品深度及資產規模，並將更多投資策略轉化為可持續收取費用的管理產品。
在第二季資產監管規模已達4.041兆美元、另類投資規模達4590億美元之際，高盛仍透過併購加速擴張。若NEOS與LCN交易最終順利完成，加上今年已完成的Innovator收購，高盛在ETF、另類投資及房地產等領域的版圖將進一步擴大，也意味著資產與財富管理業務可能在未來幾年扮演更加重要的角色。
對投資人而言，高盛近期的「買買買」並不只是追求規模，而是試圖建立更具經常性、可預測性的收入來源。在投資銀行與交易市場仍可能受到經濟周期及金融市場波動影響的情況下，能夠持續擴大管理資產並收取管理費的資產與財富管理業務，正逐漸成為高盛長期成長策略的重要支柱。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs Group (GS-US) has recently intensified its expansion of its asset and wealth management footprint, announcing the acquisition of ETF provider NEOS Investments and commercial real estate investment firm LCN Capital Partners within just six days, with a combined transaction value of about $2.66 billion. The two deals respectively target option‑strategy ETFs and the commercial real‑estate sale‑and‑leaseback market, underscoring Goldman’s continued investment of capital and resources into relatively stable, recurring management‑fee‑generating businesses.

On August 12, Goldman announced it would acquire NEOS Investments for up to $2.25 billion in cash and stock. NEOS, founded in 2022, currently manages about $30 billion in assets and offers 19 yield‑enhancing ETFs centered on option strategies, which use derivatives to boost returns, manage downside risk, and provide monthly income.

The transaction is expected to close in Q1 2027, with a maximum purchase price of $2.25 billion, the actual amount depending on NEOS meeting specific performance and service commitments. After closing, NEOS co‑founders Troy Cates and Garrett Paolella will join Goldman’s asset‑management division as partners, and the entire NEOS team is expected to join Goldman.

Goldman said NEOS is highly complementary to its existing business. The firm has already positioned itself in option‑based ETF strategies through its Innovator Capital Management platform, completing the acquisition of Innovator in April for about $2 billion. With NEOS on board, the two acquisitions will create a more complete option‑strategy ETF business alongside Goldman’s existing ETF platform.

Goldman noted that as of June 30 2026, the company, Innovator, and NEOS together manage over $130 billion in ETF assets, with NEOS alone managing $30 billion. After the deal, Goldman’s active‑ETF assets are projected to reach $80 billion, making it the world’s eighth‑largest active‑ETF manager.

NEOS operates in a rapidly growing market. Goldman cited Morningstar data showing that global derivative‑based yield ETFs manage about $180 billion in assets, with a compound annual growth rate of over 70% since 2021, making it one of the fastest‑growing ETF categories. Investor demand for yield, tax efficiency, and downside risk management is driving rapid expansion of these products.

Just six days after announcing the NEOS acquisition, Goldman announced on August 18 that it would acquire commercial real‑estate investment firm LCN Capital Partners for up to $410 million, with about $260 million payable at closing and up to $150 million tied to future performance and service commitments. Approximately 80% of the purchase price will be paid in Goldman shares, and the deal is expected to close by the end of 2026.

LCN Capital, founded in 2011, manages about $3 billion in assets and focuses on sale‑and‑leaseback and triple‑net lease strategies. These transactions typically involve a company selling its own real‑estate and then leasing it back, freeing capital for the company while investors receive relatively stable rental income.

After acquiring LCN, co‑founders Edward V. LaPuma and Bryan York Colwell, along with their team, will join Goldman’s asset‑management division’s real‑estate platform. Goldman believes this acquisition will expand its ability to serve institutional investors, insurance companies, and wealth‑management clients, and further penetrate the sale‑and‑leaseback market.

When viewed together, the two deals illustrate Goldman’s asset‑management strategy: on one hand, expanding active‑ETF and option‑strategy products through NEOS and Innovator; on the other, broadening real‑estate and alternative‑investment capabilities through LCN, thereby increasing product variety and expanding the asset base that generates management fees and related income.

This strategy aligns with Goldman’s recent business transformation. Compared to investment banking, equity trading, and fixed‑income trading—businesses vulnerable to market cycles—asset and wealth management can build more stable recurring revenue through management fees, advisory fees, and other related income.

Goldman’s second‑quarter 2026 asset‑and‑wealth‑management net revenue reached $4.597 billion, up 20% from about $3.83 billion a year earlier and 13% from about $4.07 billion in Q1, with management and other fee income hitting $3.355 billion, a record that reflects the growing asset base translating into higher recurring income.

As of the end of June, Goldman’s asset‑and‑wealth‑management AUS reached $4.041 trillion, up $391 billion from Q1’s $3.65 trillion and $748 billion from Q2 2025’s $3.293 trillion. This is the first time Goldman’s AUS has surpassed the $4 trillion threshold.

Within that, alternative‑investment AUS reached $459 billion, up from $429 billion in Q1 and $371 billion a year earlier; equity assets were $1.123 trillion, fixed‑income assets $1.394 trillion, and liquidity products $1.065 trillion.

In Q2, Goldman’s long‑term asset net inflow was $91 billion, with $56 billion from third‑party distribution channels, $19 billion from wealth‑management clients, and $16 billion from institutional clients; total asset net inflow, including liquidity products, reached $230 billion, with an additional $161 billion from market appreciation.

Alternative investments are also a core area of Goldman’s recent expansion. Q2 alternative‑investment AUS grew by $30 billion, with third‑party alternative‑investment fundraising setting a new quarterly record of $59 billion. Goldman’s presentation showed alternative‑investment management and other fee income reached $725 million in Q2, up 22% from a year earlier.

Goldman’s overall Q2 performance was strong. The company’s Q2 net revenue was $20.338 billion, net income $6.628 billion, diluted EPS $20.98, and annualized ROE 23.5%. The robust asset‑and‑wealth‑management business is becoming a key pillar of overall performance.

Goldman’s strategy is not merely to expand asset‑management scale, but to build a complete product ecosystem from institutional investors to high‑net‑worth clients. Through ETFs, alternative investments, private markets, real‑estate, and wealth‑management services, the firm can transform complex, previously institution‑centric strategies into products that are easier to sell to high‑net‑worth individuals and wealth‑management clients.

Private markets are particularly attractive. Goldman has continued to expand private‑equity, private‑credit, infrastructure, and real‑estate alternative‑investment products, and uses its asset‑management platform to bring institutional‑level opportunities to a broader wealth‑management client base.

This model also increases Goldman’s stickiness with high‑net‑worth clients. When clients use ETFs, alternative investments, private markets, and wealth‑management services simultaneously, Goldman not only earns transaction revenue but also builds longer‑term income through management fees and other services.

From an industry perspective, asset‑management firms face rapid ETF growth, passive‑investment competition, and fee‑pressure, prompting large financial institutions to acquire distinctive ETF firms to gain differentiated products and distribution capabilities. Goldman’s successive acquisitions of Innovator and NEOS are part of this industry consolidation wave.

Meanwhile, the LCN deal signals that Goldman is not limiting its asset‑management expansion to public‑market products, but also extending into commercial real‑estate and other alternative assets. Sale‑and‑leaseback strategies provide inflation‑linked and tangible‑asset‑related income streams, helping Goldman offer more diversified allocation tools to institutional and wealth‑management clients.

Thus, although the two deals belong to ETFs and commercial real‑estate and appear unrelated, they ultimately point to the same strategy: expanding Goldman’s asset‑and‑wealth‑management platform’s product depth and asset scale, and converting more investment strategies into sustainable fee‑generating products.

With AUS at $4.041 trillion and alternative‑investment AUS at $459 billion in Q2, Goldman continues to accelerate growth through acquisitions. If the NEOS and LCN deals close successfully, combined with the already completed Innovator acquisition, Goldman’s footprint in ETFs, alternative investments, and real‑estate will expand further, implying that asset‑and‑wealth‑management could play an even more important role in the coming years.

For investors, Goldman’s recent “buy‑buy‑buy” is not just about scale but about building more recurring, predictable income. While investment banking and trading markets may still be affected by economic cycles and market volatility, the ability to continuously grow assets under management and collect management fees is gradually becoming a key pillar of Goldman’s long‑term growth strategy.

As processes continue to evolve toward advanced nodes, the ability of carriers to create a high‑cleanliness protective environment will be a decisive factor.

items.title_en: Focus Stocks: Strong Earnings Lift Stock Prices; Guangsheng and Qian Ding Surge Against the Wind, Half‑Day Limit Up
paras: 台廠光通訊供應鏈受惠於AI資料中心光模組市場爆發，下半年訂單持續增溫，近期公告數據中，包括光聖(6442-TW)、前鼎(4908-TW)2家光通訊廠受惠業績亮眼，光聖昨(9)日公告8月營收，不僅年月雙增，更繳出單月歷史次高佳績，前鼎則自結7月獲利年增140％，激勵今(10)日股價雙雙開高走高，盤中價量齊揚攻上半根漲停板。

前鼎則自結今年7月單月獲利2,400萬元、年增140%、EPS為0.31元，前7月合併營收6.19億元、年增達28.19%，前鼎上半年稅後純益1.11億元、年增59.57%，EPS為1.42元，高於去年同期的0.89元。
前鼎則持續布局AI高速光通訊應用，公司指出，隨著CW雷射Chip on Carrier(CoC)產線在第3季底完成建置，也同步推進CPO 相關持續產品開發，隨著輝達(NVDA-US)採用CPO技術的矽光交換器正式邁入量產，將帶動光纖與關鍵零組件需求大爆發。
paras_en: Taiwan’s optical‑communication supply chain is benefiting from the explosion of AI data‑center optical modules, with orders warming up in the second half of the year. Recent disclosures show that two optical‑communication firms, Guangsheng (6442‑TW) and Qian Ding (4908‑TW), posted impressive results. Guangsheng announced its August revenue yesterday (Sept. 9), achieving double‑digit growth year‑over‑year and posting the second‑highest monthly figure in its history. Qian Ding reported a 140% year‑over‑year profit increase for July, prompting both stocks to open higher on Oct. 10 and climb to the half‑day limit‑up price with strong volume.

Guangsheng reported August revenue of NT$1.628 billion, up 32.44% month‑over‑month and 152.24% year‑over‑year, marking the second‑highest monthly record in the company’s history. For the year to date (Jan‑Aug 2026), consolidated revenue reached NT$9.244 billion, a 42.6% increase year‑over‑year.

Institutional investors said Guangsheng’s August revenue was mainly driven by the continued robust growth of the optical‑communication market. The company is still benefiting from strong demand from major U.S. customers, and as AI applications push higher optical‑transmission specifications, demand and shipment share for high‑capacity fiber products have risen, further fueling operating growth. In addition to AI data‑center business, Guangsheng is expanding into RF and high‑frequency connector applications.

Qian Ding posted a July profit of NT$24 million, a 140% year‑over‑year rise, with earnings per share (EPS) of NT$0.31. For the first seven months, consolidated revenue was NT$619 million, up 28.19% year‑over‑year. In the first half of the year, after‑tax net profit reached NT$111 million, a 59.57% increase, with EPS of NT$1.42, compared with NT$0.89 in the same period last year.

Qian Ding continues to position itself in AI‑high‑speed optical‑communication applications. The company noted that the CW laser Chip‑on‑Carrier (CoC) production line will be completed by the end of Q3, and it is simultaneously advancing CPO‑related product development. With NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) adopting CPO technology for silicon‑photonic switches now entering mass production, demand for optical fibers and key components is expected to explode.

items.title: 惠譽看台灣：證券業上半年獲利狂飆325% 但大小券商結構差距恐擴大
items.title_en: Fitch Views Taiwan: Securities Industry Profit Soars 325% in H1 but Gap Between Large and Small Brokers May Widen
paras: 惠譽信評今（10）日發布最新評估指出，台灣證券業2026年上半年表現極為強勁，整體行業淨利年增325%，年化股東權益報酬率從2025年的14.6%暴升至34.1%。雖然近期市場波動加劇，但在強勁獲利支撐下，下半年獲利韌性仍可維持。然而，亮眼數據背後反映出大小型券商差距持續擴大，小型券商結構性脆弱性升高，若市場環境反轉，營運弱點將更加浮現。
受益於熱絡的市場活動，2026年上半年自營、經紀與承銷收入全面成長。全市場日均成交量創下390億美元歷史新高，較2025年水準增加133%；融資餘額升至250億美元，增幅達73%。大型券商憑藉集團綜效、數位平台及旗下投信擴大的ETF產品線，順利吸納機構資金與散戶轉向ETF的趨勢，市場地位持續鞏固；相較之下，小型券商業務多元化不足，過度依賴自營收入且經紀市佔率持續流失。
資產負債表方面，前十大券商調整後淨槓桿倍數由2025年底的7.4倍升至9.6倍，主因交割資產增加93%、高度擔保放款曝險增加52%，以及台股上半年大漲59%帶動投資部位評價利益增加20%。惠譽認為槓桿上升不代表風險等比例增加，由於交割應收款存續期短，且放款有充分擔保與嚴格風控，7月及8月市場修正期間已有效控制信用損失。
展望後市，惠譽預期多數券商受惠於保留盈餘與資產負債表管理，即使槓桿上升仍能維持適切的資本緩衝與流動性。若市場活動降溫，槓桿水準亦可能隨之回落。大型券商風險管理政策執行較佳，能承受市場衝擊；小型券商若缺乏多角化布局，在市場反轉時營運風險依然較高。
paras_en: Fitch Ratings released its latest assessment today (the 10th), noting that Taiwan’s securities industry showed extremely strong performance in the first half of 2026, with overall industry net profit up 325% year‑over‑year and the annualized return on equity jumping from 14.6% in 2025 to 34.1%. Although recent market volatility has intensified, the robust earnings base should keep profit resilience intact for the second half. Behind the impressive figures, however, the gap between large and small brokers continues to widen, raising structural fragility for smaller firms; a market reversal would likely expose their operational weaknesses more sharply.

Benefiting from lively market activity, proprietary trading, brokerage and underwriting revenues all grew in the first half of 2026. The market’s average daily turnover hit a historic high of US$39 billion, 133% higher than the 2025 level, while margin balances rose to US$25 billion, a 73% increase. Large brokers leveraged group synergies, digital platforms and expanded ETF product lines from their asset‑management arms to attract institutional capital and retail investors shifting to ETFs, further solidifying their market position. In contrast, smaller brokers lack diversification, rely heavily on proprietary trading income, and are losing brokerage market share.

On the balance‑sheet side, the adjusted net leverage ratio of the top ten brokers rose from 7.4× at the end of 2025 to 9.6×, driven mainly by a 93% increase in settlement assets, a 52% rise in highly‑collateralised loan exposure, and a 59% surge in the Taiwan stock index in the first half that boosted valuation gains on investment positions by 20%. Fitch believes the higher leverage does not translate into proportionally higher risk because settlement receivables have short maturities and the loans are well‑collateralised with strict risk controls; credit losses were effectively contained during the market correction in July and August.

Looking ahead, Fitch expects most brokers to benefit from retained earnings and balance‑sheet management, allowing them to maintain adequate capital buffers and liquidity despite higher leverage. Should market activity cool, leverage levels may also retreat. Large brokers, with stronger risk‑management policies, are better positioned to absorb market shocks, whereas smaller brokers lacking diversified business models would face higher operational risk if the market turns.

paras: 2026年09月10日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 微星上半年在零組件短缺與漲價壓力下，靠產品組合優化與漲價策略逆勢突圍，毛利率攀升至15.97%，帶動上半年每股盈餘達8.42元。
下半年全力押注RTX Spark AI PC新品與AI伺服器放量，非PC事業逐步進入收成期。

[Image source: Youshi Industry Database]
LuckyClaw positions itself in the enterprise AI Agent space, extending hardware into software services

In mid‑August the company launched its own AI Agent platform, “LuckyClaw,” which emphasizes a hybrid cloud‑edge computing model that handles high‑frequency routine tasks locally and reserves the cloud for complex inference. Internal tests show that, in marketing‑automation scenarios, enterprises can cut monthly AI costs by 70%, and the platform integrates with common tools such as LINE, Gmail and Slack, promising synergistic hardware‑software integration with AI PCs and RTX Spark devices.
[Image source: Youshi Industry Database]
AI servers are rapidly catching up, targeting a doubling of revenue by 2026

The company aims for AI server revenue to exceed NT$10 billion in 2026, representing a multiple‑fold increase over 2025. U.S. factories have already begun shipping MGX AI servers to small‑ and medium‑size enterprises in North America, although AI server revenue currently accounts for only a single‑digit percentage of total sales.

Institutions acknowledge the company’s strategic direction but point out that large U.S. customers still mainly work through long‑standing major ODMs, while MSI’s orders are largely from small‑ and medium‑size clients, which could compress margins in the short term.
[Image source: Youshi Industry Database]
Risk reminder: AI server business started late and traditional business remains heavily relied upon

Compared with peers, MSI’s AI server business started later and is constrained by chip supply, so the timing of volume expansion remains uncertain; moreover, PC and board‑level traditional businesses still represent a large share of revenue, and a weaker-than‑expected consumer electronics recovery could affect short‑term profit stability.

Future watch points include whether AI server revenue can double as scheduled, whether RTX Spark sales momentum can be sustained, and whether AI‑related investments will dilute or enhance gross margin.

items.title: 玉山金(2884)跨入「金控2.0」！併三商壽補齊版圖，2027年迎來真正驗收期
items.title_en: Yuanta Financial (2884) Enters "Financial Group 2.0"! Completes Acquisition of Sansong Life to Complete Its Map, Real Test Begins in 2027
paras: 2026年09月10日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 玉山金(2884-TW)今（10）日盤中最高來到45.75元、漲幅3.39%，逼近52週高點46.05元。除了金融股成為震盪盤面的資金避風港，市場也開始重新評價玉山金完成三商壽併購後的成長空間。
玉山金已於9月1日完成三商美邦人壽股權交割，三商壽正式成為100%持股子公司。合併後玉山金資產規模突破6.6兆元，躍升為國內第五大上市金控，也正式補齊銀行、人壽、證券與投信四大金融版圖。

玉山金為什麼需要三商壽？
玉山金過去的強項集中在銀行業務，信用卡、財富管理、放款及手續費收入表現穩定，但缺少壽險子公司，也限制了金融商品與客戶經營的廣度。
收購三商壽後，玉山金不只取得保戶與保單資產，也一次納入逾8,000名自有業務員，補足過去主要依賴銀行據點銷售保險的通路缺口。
玉山銀行已於2026年3月上架三商壽的房貸壽險及美元利率變動型保單。未來除了透過銀行通路銷售更多保險商品，也能將玉山的信用卡、基金與財富管理服務，導入三商壽既有客戶與業務員通路。
因此，這場併購真正的價值，不只在三商壽本身能賺多少，而是雙方客戶與通路能否互相導流。
(圖片來源:優分析產業資料庫)

先買投信、再併壽險，玉山金在下一盤什麼棋？
三商壽不是玉山金近期唯一的併購。
2025年玉山金完成保德信投信收購，重新建立基金發行、全權委託及資產管理能力；2026年再將三商壽納入旗下，顯示其併購策略是先補齊資產管理，再擴大保險與財富管理版圖。
未來玉山銀行可以掌握客戶資金與交易需求，玉山投信負責基金及資產管理商品，三商壽則提供長期保險與退休規劃，形成從存款、投資到保險的一站式金融服務。
這也代表玉山金正由「銀行主導的金控」，逐步轉型為能夠管理客戶完整資產生命週期的金融集團。

IRB上路，替併購整合補充資本空間
壽險業務需要較高的資本支撐，也是這次併購最需要注意的地方。
玉山銀預計自2026年第四季採用信用風險內部評等法（IRB），首年可望使普通股權益第一類資本比率增加0.5至0.6個百分點，約相當於130至140億元的增資效益。
雖然這不等同於直接增加現金，也不能完全抵銷三商壽的資本需求，但能提高資本使用效率，降低玉山金為了整合壽險業務而對外現金增資、稀釋股東權益的壓力。
加上2026年上半年淨利息收入年增26%、淨手續費收入年增26.9%，代表玉山金原有銀行本業仍具備成長動能，有助於支撐併購後的資本需求。

2026年貢獻有限，2027年才是真正驗收期
由於三商壽直到2026年第三季末才正式納入，對玉山金今年獲利的影響仍有限，真正的併購綜效預計要從2027年開始觀察。
後續有三項重要指標：

銀行通路能否帶動三商壽保單銷售
三商壽業務員能否協助銷售玉山的金融商品
三商壽的資本結構、避險成本及獲利能力能否改善

壽險獲利容易受到利率、匯率及資本市場波動影響，玉山金取得新的成長引擎，也等於承接新的經營風險。因此，資產規模升至第五大只是第一步，能否把三商壽由資本負擔轉化為穩定獲利來源，才是併購成敗的關鍵。
整體而言，玉山金正在從「本業表現穩健的銀行股」，轉向具有投信與壽險成長空間的完整金控。市場現在交易的是併購後的想像空間，但真正決定評價能否繼續提高的時間點，將落在2027年的綜效驗收。

paras_en: On September 10, 2026 (Yuan Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – Yuanta Financial (2884‑TW) reached a high of 45.75 during the day, up 3.39%, approaching its 52‑week high of 46.05. In addition to financial stocks becoming a safe haven amid market volatility, investors are re‑evaluating Yuanta’s growth prospects after completing the acquisition of Sansong Life.

Yuanta completed the share transfer of Sansong Meibang Life on September 1, making Sansong Life a 100% owned subsidiary. After the merger, Yuanta’s asset size surpassed 6.6 trillion, making it the fifth largest listed financial group in Taiwan and completing its banking, life insurance, securities, and asset‑management portfolio.

Why does Yuanta need Sansong Life? Yuanta’s past strengths have focused on banking, with stable performance in credit cards, wealth management, lending, and fee income, but the lack of a life‑insurance subsidiary limited the breadth of financial products and customer relationships.

After acquiring Sansong Life, Yuanta not only gained policyholders and policy assets but also incorporated over 8,000 in‑house agents, filling the sales channel gap that previously relied mainly on bank branches for insurance.

Yuanta Bank listed Sansong Life’s mortgage life insurance and USD‑rate‑linked policies in March 2026. In the future, it will sell more insurance products through bank channels and introduce Yuanta’s credit cards, funds, and wealth‑management services to Sansong Life’s existing customers and agents.
Thus, the true value of this acquisition lies not just in how much Sansong Life can earn, but whether the two parties’ customers and channels can cross‑drive each other.
(Image source: Yuan Analysis Industry Database)
Buying asset‑management first, then life insurance – what’s Yuanta’s next move? Sansong Life is not Yuanta’s only recent acquisition.

In 2025, Yuanta completed the acquisition of Prudential Investment Trust, re‑establishing its fund issuance, full‑delegation, and asset‑management capabilities; in 2026 it added Sansong Life, showing a strategy of first completing asset management, then expanding insurance and wealth‑management.

In the future, Yuanta Bank can capture customer funds and transaction needs, Yuanta Investment Trust handles funds and asset‑management products, and Sansong Life provides long‑term insurance and retirement planning, creating a one‑stop financial service from deposits to investments to insurance.
This also means Yuanta is shifting from a "bank‑led financial group" to a group that can manage the entire asset lifecycle of its customers.
IRB rollout provides capital space for integration of the acquisition. Life insurance requires higher capital support, which is a key concern in this deal.

Yuanta Bank plans to adopt the Internal Rating‑Based (IRB) credit risk assessment method from Q4 2026, which could increase its Tier‑1 capital ratio by 0.5 to 0.6 percentage points in the first year, roughly equivalent to a 13 to 14 billion‑yuan capital raise.

Although this is not the same as directly increasing cash and cannot fully offset Sansong Life’s capital needs, it improves capital efficiency and reduces the pressure on Yuanta to raise external cash or dilute shareholder equity for integrating the life‑insurance business.

With net interest income up 26% year‑on‑year and net fee income up 26.9% in the first half of 2026, Yuanta’s core banking business still has growth momentum, helping support post‑acquisition capital needs.

Limited contribution in 2026, real test begins in 2027. Since Sansong Life only officially joined at the end of Q3 2026, its impact on Yuanta’s 2026 earnings is still limited; the true synergy of the acquisition is expected to be observed from 2027 onward.

Three key indicators moving forward: 1) Can bank channels drive Sansong Life policy sales? 2) Can Sansong Life agents help sell Yuanta’s financial products? 3) Can Sansong Life’s capital structure, hedging costs, and profitability improve?

Life‑insurance profitability is easily affected by interest rates, exchange rates, and capital‑market volatility. Yuanta’s new growth engine also brings new operational risks. Thus, merely becoming the fifth‑largest asset holder is only the first step; converting Sansong Life from a capital burden to a stable profit source is the real test of the acquisition’s success.

Overall, Yuanta is moving from a "stable banking stock" to a complete financial group with growth potential in asset‑management and life insurance. The market is currently trading on the imagined space after the acquisition, but the real decision point for further valuation will be the 2027 synergy assessment.

items.title_en: Qianting (4908) NVIDIA Spectrum‑X Mass Production + 140% July Profit Surge! CPO Explosion on the Horizon!
paras:
輝達CPO量產加持，光通訊族群全面點火
輝達(NVIDIA)採用CPO技術的矽光交換器正式邁入量產，帶動光纖與關鍵零組件需求大爆發，而前鼎已成功打入供應鏈。前鼎在此領域鎖定核心的「外置雷射光源模組(ELSFP)」技術，並全力建置雷射CoC產線，預計於 2026年第三季底完工；屆時不僅能滿足自家生產需求，更能接單提供代工服務，為公司添增強勁的長期營運動能。

營運實績7月獲利大增，高速模組放量啟動
前鼎自結2026年7月單月獲利2,400萬元(年增140%)、EPS0.31元，寫下亮眼成績，對照2025年全年營收8.15億、EPS 僅1.98元，顯見2026年營運已由衰退轉向復甦，終於在2026年下半年進入「高速光模組量產」與「CPO關鍵零組件開發」的雙軌收割期。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫)

高速光模組產品線完備，量產是最大分水嶺
光收發模組為前鼎最主要營收來源，佔整體營收比重85%以上，且以資料中心相關的100G／400G／800G產品為成長主力。前鼎各產品線進展如下：

前鼎未來動能3大焦點：營收續航、800G量產與代工接單
前鼎的營運觀察焦點將明確落在三大轉折指標上：首先是8月與9月的營收延續力道，若單月營收能穩定站上1億元大關且年增率同步擴大，將進一步確認高速模組已強勢進入穩定出貨軌道；其次是800G產品的實際放量時程，市場正緊盯後續法說會能否明確拋出800G營收占比目標；最後則聚焦於CPO產線完工後的效益，預計2026年第三季完成的自建CoC產線，能否順利轉化為外部代工訂單，將是推升下一波股價的關鍵催化劑。

paras_en: NVIDIA’s CPO‑enabled silicon photonic switch has entered mass production, sparking a boom in fiber optics and key components, and Qianting has successfully entered the supply chain. The company focuses on the core "external laser light source module (ELSFP)" technology and is building a laser CoC production line, expected to be completed by the end of Q3 2026. At that time, it will not only meet its own production needs but also take on OEM orders, adding strong long‑term operating momentum.

Qianting’s July 2026 results were impressive, with a monthly profit of 24 million NTD (140% YoY) and EPS of 0.31 NTD. Compared with 2025’s full‑year revenue of 815 million NTD and EPS of only 1.98 NTD, the company’s operations have shifted from decline to recovery, entering a dual‑track harvest period of "high‑speed photonic module mass production" and "CPO key component development" in the second half of 2026.
(Data source: You Analysis Industry Database)

The high‑speed photonic module product line is complete, and mass production is the biggest watershed. The optical transceiver module is Qianting’s main revenue source, accounting for over 85% of total revenue, with 100G/400G/800G data‑center products as the growth engine.

Qianting’s future momentum focuses on three key turning points: first, the revenue sustainability in August and September; if monthly revenue can consistently exceed 100 million NTD with a growing YoY rate, it will confirm that the high‑speed module has firmly entered a stable shipping track. Second, the actual ramp‑up schedule for the 800G product; the market is watching whether the subsequent earnings call will clearly state the 800G revenue share target. Third, the benefit after the CPO line is completed; the self‑built CoC line expected to finish in Q3 2026 will be a key catalyst for the next wave of stock price appreciation if it can smoothly convert into external OEM orders.

items.title: 緯穎第四季展望樂觀 下半年資本支出近300億元 明年將再上調
items.title_en: Wiying Forecasts Optimistic for Q4, Capital Expenditure Near 30 Billion NTD in H2, Further Increase Planned Next Year
paras: 緯穎(6669-TW)8月營收達1443.12億元，年增5成，再度創歷史單月新高紀錄，管理層今(10)日指出，目前整體營收與存貨能量充足，第四季展望樂觀。此外，今年下半年規劃資本支出9.42億美元(約新台幣296.63億元)，預期明年將再上調。
緯穎表示，上半年伺服器出貨以通用型伺服器為主，預期第三季通用型與ASIC將黃金交叉，比重各半，ASIC將在第四季超越通用型，第四季季底也將有GPU伺服器出貨。
緯穎第二季毛利率9.26%，緯穎指出，由於第二季有NRE研發收入貢獻，因此帶動毛利率改善，並預期下半年ASIC伺服器比重提升，即便產品組合改變，毛利率變化不大，不過還需觀察NRE貢獻程度。
產能規劃上，緯穎表示，目前美國廠已投產，主要生產L10、L11，將逐步擴大水冷機種產能。美國廠加入生產行列前，墨西哥廠產能比重占7成，馬來西亞占2成，歐洲1成，美國廠投產後，產能比重將有變化，明年美國廠產能目標提升至2成。
至於缺料狀況，緯穎則提到，雖料況供應緊張，其中又以CPU最為吃緊，但未嚴重短缺。而緯穎採用代採購模式，主要用於通用型伺服器專案。
資本支出方面，緯穎今年上半年資本支出120億元，並規劃下半年資本支出9.42億美元 (約新台幣296.63億元) ，預計明年將進一步上調，主要用於台灣、馬來西亞等地廠區興建，以及各廠的水冷、電力等基礎設施與產線設置。
針對畸零股爭議，緯穎今天也補充，除持有1至15股的股東可以以面額10元認購1股，已湊足整股的股東，仍可參與認購。而緯穎也提到，雖目前尚未確認交割時間，但強調會盡快處理。
paras_en: Wiying (6669‑TW) reported revenue of 144.312 billion NTD in August, a 50% year‑on‑year increase, setting a new record for the highest single‑month revenue. Management stated on the 10th that overall revenue and inventory levels are sufficient, and the outlook for Q4 is optimistic. In addition, the company plans capital expenditures of 942 million USD (approximately 29.663 billion NTD) for the second half of the year, with expectations of further increases next year.

Wiying’s August revenue of 144.312 billion NTD grew 22.62% month‑on‑month and 50.36% year‑on‑year; cumulative revenue for the first eight months of the year reached 816.658 billion NTD, up 42.8% year‑on‑year.

Wiying noted that server shipments in the first half were dominated by general‑purpose servers. It expects a golden cross in Q3 between general‑purpose and ASIC servers, with each accounting for roughly half of shipments. ASIC shipments are projected to surpass general‑purpose in Q4, and GPU server shipments are also expected by the end of Q4.

Wiying’s gross margin in Q2 was 9.26%. The company attributed the improvement to NRE R&D revenue contributions in Q2 and expects the ASIC server mix to increase in the second half. Even with changes in product mix, margin changes should be minimal, though the impact of NRE contributions will need monitoring.

Regarding capacity planning, Wiying said its U.S. plant is now in production, mainly producing L10 and L11 models, and will gradually expand capacity for water‑cooled models. Before the U.S. plant joined production, the Mexico plant accounted for 70% of capacity, Malaysia 20%, and Europe 10%. After the U.S. plant began production, capacity proportions will shift, with the U.S. plant’s target capacity set to rise to 20% next year.

On material shortages, Wiying mentioned that while supply is tight—especially for CPUs—there is no severe shortage. The company uses a proxy procurement model, primarily for general‑purpose server projects.

In terms of capital expenditures, Wiying spent 12 billion NTD in the first half of the year and plans 942 million USD (about 29.663 billion NTD) for the second half, with further increases expected next year. These funds will be used for construction of facilities in Taiwan, Malaysia, and other locations, as well as for water‑cooling, power, and other infrastructure and line‑setup at each plant.

Regarding the share‑holder dispute, Wiying added today that shareholders holding 1 to 15 shares can subscribe at a nominal price of 10 NTD per share to acquire whole shares, and those who already have whole shares can also participate in the subscription. Wiying also noted that while the delivery date has not yet been confirmed, it will be processed as soon as possible.

items.title: 蘋果也扛不住記憶體漲價！法人：AI紅利擴散 00891迎Q4電子旺季
paras: 受到全球AI資料中心擴建熱潮帶動，記憶體市場供需持續吃緊，DRAM與NAND Flash價格明顯走揚，市場傳出蘋果新一代iPhone售價平均調漲約10%，引發市場關注「AI通膨」效應是否正式來臨。這波紅利正從GPU延伸至記憶體、先進封裝及測試等半導體供應鏈。投資人可透過布局台積電(2330-TW)、聯發科(2454-TW)及記憶體龍頭的中信關鍵半導體ETF(00891-TW)，全面掌握第四季旺季與AI長線趨勢帶來的產業受惠契機。
法人指出，隨著AI伺服器、高效能運算與大型資料中心持續擴大建置，記憶體產能優先供應高階AI應用，使整體供給趨於緊張。在記憶體成本大幅攀升下，即便擁有強大品牌力與議價能力的蘋果，也難以完全自行吸收新增成本，最終仍須透過產品售價調整反映部分壓力。
當記憶體價格上漲時，最直接受惠的將是DRAM與NAND供應商，而在AI伺服器、資料中心與高效能運算需求同步成長帶動下，相關供應鏈企業的獲利能力亦有機會持續提升。市場普遍認為，AI投資主軸正從過去聚焦GPU晶片，逐步擴大至記憶體、先進封裝、高速傳輸及半導體測試等領域，帶動更完整的產業受惠生態系形成。
以中信關鍵半導體ETF(00891-TW)為例，目前成分股涵蓋台灣半導體產業核心龍頭，其中台積電與聯發科權重合計超過53%，同時納入日月光投控、創意、旺矽、京元電及力成等先進封裝與半導體測試領域重要企業，完整布局AI時代關鍵供應鏈。
此外，在記憶體產業方面，00891亦持有華邦電、南亞科及愛普等記憶體相關個股。若後續DRAM與NAND價格維持高檔，相關企業獲利表現可望維持強勁，ETF也有機會從中受惠。
中信關鍵半導體ETF經理人張圭慧表示，目前市場焦點多集中在AI晶片龍頭表現，但AI產業紅利並非由單一企業獨享，而是從晶圓代工、IC設計、記憶體、先進封裝到測試驗證等完整供應鏈共同受惠。隨著全球AI基礎建設持續擴張，產業成長紅利可望逐步擴散至更多半導體環節。
展望後市，張圭慧指出，第四季向來為科技產業傳統旺季，包括AI伺服器、智慧型手機及消費電子新品出貨需求均有機會增溫。若全球AI資本支出維持高檔，加上半導體景氣復甦趨勢延續，台灣半導體供應鏈仍有望成為市場資金聚焦的核心族群。
張圭慧進一步表示，近期市場震盪主要來自短期資金面與評價面調整，但從產業基本面觀察，AI需求成長趨勢並未改變。在第四季旺季效應及AI長線需求支撐下，半導體產業仍具備持續成長潛力。

items.title: iPhone首度支援Apple Pencil！Duo讓Touch ID重返旗艦機
items.title_en: iPhone Supports Apple Pencil for the First Time! Duo Brings Touch ID Back to Flagship Models
paras: 蘋果首款摺疊智慧手機iPhone Duo 正式亮相，不僅採用可展開的大尺寸螢幕，更打破iPhone問世近20年來的產品慣例，首度支援Apple Pencil。蘋果也捨棄近年旗艦iPhone慣用的Face ID，改將Touch ID整合至側邊按鈕，讓指紋辨識重新回到高階iPhone。
iPhone Duo採書本式摺疊設計，機身閉合時可透過5.4吋外螢幕操作，展開後則提供7.6吋內螢幕。較大的顯示空間可同時開啟兩款App，或並排顯示同一款App的兩個視窗，讓使用方式更接近小型iPad。
蘋果過去一直未讓iPhone支援Apple Pencil，相關功能主要局限於iPad產品線。
隨著Duo展開後的螢幕面積增加，使用者未來可利用Apple Pencil手寫筆記、繪圖、標註文件，以及進行更精細的影像編輯，滿足果迷創作需求。
不過，Apple Pencil功能不會在iPhone Duo上市當日同步開放。
蘋果表示，相關支援預計於今年稍後透過軟體更新加入，因此首批購機用戶仍須等待後續版本，才能在Duo上體驗觸控筆操作。屆時Apple Pencil可在Duo的內、外兩面螢幕使用。
iPhone Duo對Apple Pencil的相容性也有限制，目前僅支援售價79美元的USB-C版Apple Pencil，無法搭配Apple Pencil Pro。
USB-C版具備傾斜感應功能，但不支援壓力感應、雙擊切換、側旋、觸覺回饋及尋找功能。
另一項重大改變是Touch ID回歸。
iPhone Duo未搭載Face ID，而是將指紋感測器整合至機身側邊按鈕，使用者握住手機時即可完成解鎖。
這項配置與部分iPad機型相似，也可避免在摺疊機的內、外兩面配置完整Face ID感測元件。
由於iPhone Duo可能處於閉合、展開或半摺疊狀態，將Touch ID設於側邊按鈕，可讓使用者無論操作哪一面螢幕，都能從同一位置完成身分驗證。
規格方面，iPhone Duo搭載A20 Pro晶片與蘋果自研C2數據機，最高提供2TB儲存空間，並配備兩顆4,800萬畫素後置鏡頭。
iPhone Duo 將於 10 月 16 日晚間 8 時開放預購，10 月 23 日正式上市，提供星光白與夜空色兩種配色。
paras_en: Apple’s first foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, was officially unveiled, featuring a large expandable display and breaking nearly 20 years of iPhone product tradition by supporting the Apple Pencil for the first time. Apple also abandons the Face ID system used on recent flagship iPhones, integrating Touch ID into the side button so fingerprint recognition returns to high‑end iPhones.

The iPhone Duo uses a book‑style folding design; when closed, a 5.4‑inch outer screen can be used, and when opened it reveals a 7.6‑inch inner screen. The larger display area allows two apps to run side‑by‑side or two windows of the same app to be shown simultaneously, making the experience closer to that of a small iPad.
Apple has previously never allowed the iPhone to support the Apple Pencil, with related functionality limited to the iPad product line.

With the increased screen area when the Duo is unfolded, users will be able to take handwritten notes, draw, annotate documents, and perform finer‑grained photo editing with the Apple Pencil, satisfying creators’ needs.
However, Apple Pencil functionality will not be available on the iPhone Duo on launch day.

Apple says the support is expected to arrive later this year via a software update, so the first batch of buyers will have to wait for a subsequent version before they can use a stylus on the Duo. At that time the Apple Pencil will work on both the inner and outer screens of the device.
Compatibility with the Apple Pencil on the iPhone Duo is also limited; currently only the $79 USB‑C version of the Apple Pencil is supported, and the Apple Pencil Pro is not compatible.
The USB‑C version includes tilt detection but does not support pressure sensitivity, double‑tap switching, rotation, haptic feedback, or the Find My feature.
Another major change is the return of Touch ID.
The iPhone Duo does not include Face ID; instead, the fingerprint sensor is integrated into the side button, allowing the phone to be unlocked simply by holding it.
This configuration is similar to some iPad models and also avoids the need to place full Face ID sensor arrays on both the inner and outer sides of a folding device.

Because the iPhone Duo may be in a closed, fully opened, or partially folded state, placing Touch ID on the side button lets users authenticate from the same location regardless of which screen they are using.
In terms of specifications, the iPhone Duo is powered by the A20 Pro chip and Apple’s in‑house C2 modem, offers up to 2 TB of storage, and is equipped with two 48‑megapixel rear cameras.
The iPhone Duo will open for pre‑orders at 8 p.m. on October 16 and launch on October 23, available in Starlight White and Night Sky colors.

items.title: 「新債王」岡拉克：Fed若不升息 長天期美債恐再遭拋售
items.title_en: "New Bond King" Jeffrey Gundlach: If the Fed Holds Rates, Long‑Term Treasuries May Face Another Sell‑Off
paras: 有「新債王」之稱的DoubleLine Capital執行長岡拉克(Jeffrey Gundlach)周二(8日)在網路直播中示警：如果聯準會(Fed)在下周的政策會議上違背市場預期、選擇維持利率不變，長期美債殖利率可能進一步攀升，從而加劇這場歷史性的債券市場拋售。
岡拉克表示，市場定價暗示聯準會下周升息25個基點的機率約為60%，但他個人「傾向於」認為決策者最終不會採取行動。
他指出，儘管美國通膨仍然頑固、經濟活動指標強勁，他仍質疑聯準會是否有意願恢復緊縮政策。
岡拉克以對市場的前瞻性判斷著稱，曾多次預警美股估值偏高、私募信貸市場風險，並建議投資人配置黃金等實物資產。他的公開談話和網路直播受到全球固定收益投資人的密切關注，被視為債券市場的重要風向標。
政策利率與短端殖利率再度「脫節」
岡拉克特別強調聯邦基金利率與2年期美債殖利率之間的顯著差距。周二，有效聯邦基金利率為3.63%，而美國2年期國債殖利率已攀升至4.998%，兩者利差約為137個基點。
他表示，「基於2年期美債殖利率的交易水平，聯邦基金利率可能應該比當前高出約50個基點。」並指出儘管當前的錯位程度不及2022年嚴重，但政策利率與殖利率曲線短端再次出現「脫節」。
這項差距反映了市場的核心擔憂：投資人普遍認為聯準會當前的政策立場不足以遏制通膨，短期利率需要在未來兩年內保持高位，甚至進一步走高。
30年期美債的結構性脆弱
岡拉克認為，美國30年期國債仍存在結構性脆弱。自2020年低點以來，30年期殖利率經歷大規模重新定價，周二達到約5.25%，累計漲幅接近500個基點。此劇烈變動已導致長期美債出現「超過50%」的帳面虧損。
更令這位債市老將警惕的是，在殖利率如此劇烈上升之後，債券市場仍未能出現有意義的反彈。
「當殖利率已累計上行近500個基點，而市場仍無法反彈時，這通常意味著下一階段將是現有上行趨勢的延續。」岡拉克表示，並重申此前的觀點：投資人應避開「所有已開發經濟體」的長期政府債券。
他補充，雙線資本的某些基金仍持有30年期美債的單邊空頭部位，這策略近年來「表現相當不錯」。
10年期美債殖利率一直在2023年10月以來的最高水平附近交易，而最新一波拋售已將30年期殖利率推升至2007年以來的最高水平。
巨額供給壓力推高期限溢價
岡拉克將當前債券拋售歸因於多重因素，包括美國國債大量發行、企業融資需求激增，尤其是AI相關公司的債務發行，以及持續的財政赤字壓力。他認為市場「正艱難消化如此龐大的債券供給」。
他警告，結構性走高的實質殖利率、持續的通膨壓力以及巨額財政赤字，意味著期限溢價將在較長時期內保持高位。期限溢價是指投資人持有長期債券所要求的額外補償；若持續高企，意味著長端殖利率更可能上升，而非下降。
在此背景下，岡拉克明確表達了他的資產配置偏好：相較於長期美國國債，他更青睞久期較短的固定收益資產、本幣計價的新興市場債券以及實物資產。他預計，如果聯準會再次落後於通膨曲線，長期美債可能進一步走弱。
Fed決策前的關鍵數據
下周的聯準會政策會議正值市場分歧顯著之際。上周五的非農就業報告遠超預期，提振了9月升息的機率，但聯準會是否會真正恢復緊縮政策，仍存在相當大的不確定性。
作為這周投資人最大關注焦點之一，美國8月消費者物價指數(CPI)報告將於周五發布，將為聯準會下周決策提供關鍵參考。
根據CME FedWatch工具，市場目前定價聯準會9月維持利率不變的機率為40.6%，累計升息25個基點的機率為59.4%。
岡拉克的警告正值債券市場處於關鍵十字路口。如果聯準會選擇按兵不動，市場可能將其解讀為決策者在通膨壓力面前猶豫不決，從而可能推動長端殖利率突破既有區間。
反之，如果聯準會如部分市場參與者預期的那樣恢復升息，債券市場可能在當前水平附近獲得一定喘息。
無論如何，下周的聯準會決策和周五的CPI數據，都將成為決定美債市場近期方向的關鍵催化劑。
paras_en: Jeffrey Gundlach, the so‑called "New Bond King" and CEO of DoubleLine Capital, warned on Tuesday (the 8th) during a live online broadcast that if the Federal Reserve defies market expectations at next week’s policy meeting and chooses to keep rates unchanged, long‑term U.S. Treasury yields could rise further, intensifying this historic bond market sell‑off.

Gundlach said the market pricing implies about a 60% chance that the Fed will raise rates by 25 basis points next week, but he personally "leans toward" the view that policymakers will ultimately not act.
He pointed out that despite stubborn U.S. inflation and strong economic activity indicators, he still questions whether the Fed is willing to resume a tightening stance.

Gundlach is known for his forward‑looking market judgments, having repeatedly warned of overvalued U.S. equities, risks in the private‑credit market, and advised investors to allocate to physical assets such as gold. His public talks and live streams are closely watched by global fixed‑income investors and are seen as a key barometer for the bond market.
Policy rates and short‑end yields are once again "disconnected".

Gundlach specifically highlighted the significant gap between the federal funds rate and the 2‑year Treasury yield. On Tuesday, the effective federal funds rate was 3.63%, while the U.S. 2‑year Treasury yield had risen to 4.998%, a spread of about 137 basis points.

He stated that "based on the trading level of the 2‑year Treasury yield, the federal funds rate should be about 50 basis points higher than it is now," and noted that although the current misalignment is not as severe as in 2022, policy rates and the short end of the yield curve have again become "disconnected".

This gap reflects the market’s core concern: investors generally believe the Fed’s current stance is insufficient to curb inflation, and short‑term rates need to remain high for the next two years, possibly rising further.
Structural vulnerability of the 30‑year Treasury

Gundlach believes the U.S. 30‑year Treasury still has structural vulnerability. Since the low in 2020, the 30‑year yield has undergone a massive repricing, reaching about 5.25% on Tuesday, a cumulative rise of nearly 500 basis points. This sharp change has caused long‑term Treasuries to record book losses exceeding 50%.
What further alarms this bond‑market veteran is that after such a sharp rise in yields, the bond market has not yet shown a meaningful rebound.

"When yields have risen cumulatively by almost 500 basis points and the market still cannot rebound, it usually means the next phase will be a continuation of the existing upward trend," Gundlach said, reiterating his earlier view that investors should avoid "all long‑term government bonds in developed economies."
He added that some of DoubleLine’s funds still hold unilateral short positions on 30‑year Treasuries, a strategy that has performed "quite well" in recent years.
The 10‑year Treasury yield has been trading near its highest level since October 2023, and the latest sell‑off has pushed the 30‑year yield to its highest level since 2007.
Large supply pressure pushes up the term premium

Gundlach attributes the current bond sell‑off to multiple factors, including large U.S. Treasury issuances, a surge in corporate financing demand—especially debt issuances by AI‑related companies—and ongoing fiscal‑deficit pressure. He believes the market is "struggling to digest such a massive supply of bonds."

He warned that structurally higher real yields, persistent inflationary pressure, and massive fiscal deficits mean the term premium will remain high for a long period. The term premium is the additional compensation investors require to hold long‑term bonds; if it stays high, long‑end yields are more likely to rise rather than fall.

Against this backdrop, Gundlach made his asset‑allocation preference clear: compared to long‑term U.S. Treasuries, he favors shorter‑duration fixed‑income assets, home‑currency‑denominated emerging‑market bonds, and physical assets. He expects that if the Fed again lags behind the inflation curve, long‑term Treasuries may weaken further.
Key data before the Fed decision

Next week’s Fed policy meeting comes at a time of significant market division. The non‑farm payroll report from last Friday far exceeded expectations, boosting the odds of a September rate hike, but whether the Fed will truly resume tightening remains highly uncertain.
One of the biggest investor concerns this week is the U.S. August CPI report, due on Friday, which will provide a key reference for next week’s Fed decision.
According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market currently prices a 40.6% chance that the Fed will keep rates unchanged in September, and a 59.4% chance of a 25‑basis‑point hike.

Gundlach’s warning comes at a critical crossroads for the bond market. If the Fed chooses to stand pat, the market may interpret this as indecision in the face of inflationary pressure, potentially driving long‑end yields to break out of their existing range.
Conversely, if the Fed resumes hikes as some market participants expect, the bond market may gain some breathing room at current levels.
Regardless, next week’s Fed decision and Friday’s CPI data will be the key catalysts determining the short‑term direction of the U.S. Treasury market.

items.title: 瘋狂買！高盛6天砸26.6億美元連收NEOS、LCN 狂攻ETF、房地產 與另類投資
items.title_en: Crazy Buying! Goldman Sachs Dumps $2.66 Billion in Six Days, Acquiring NEOS, LCN, and Launching a Blitz on ETFs, Real Estate, and Alternative Investments
paras: 高盛集團 (GS-US) 近期密集擴張資產與財富管理版圖，短短6天內先後宣布收購ETF業者NEOS Investments及商業房地產投資公司LCN Capital Partners，最高交易對價合計約26.6億美元。兩筆交易分別切入選擇權策略ETF與商業不動產售後回租市場，凸顯高盛正持續把資本與資源投入相對穩定、可產生經常性管理費收入的業務。
高盛8月12日宣布，將以最高22.5億美元現金及股票收購NEOS Investments。NEOS成立於2022年，目前管理約300億美元資產，旗下有19檔以選擇權策略為核心的收益型ETF，產品主要透過衍生品提高收益、管理下行風險並提供每月收益。
這筆交易預計在2027年第1季完成，交易對價最高22.5億美元，實際金額取決於NEOS未來達成特定業績及服務承諾。交易完成後，NEOS共同創辦人Troy Cates及Garrett Paolella將加入高盛資產管理部門擔任合夥人，NEOS整個團隊也預計加入高盛。
高盛表示，NEOS與既有業務具有高度互補性。高盛目前已透過Innovator Capital Management布局以選擇權為基礎的ETF策略，今年4月完成對Innovator的收購，交易對價約20億美元。隨著NEOS加入，兩筆收購將與高盛既有ETF平台形成更完整的選擇權策略ETF業務。
高盛指出，截至2026年6月30日，公司、Innovator及NEOS合計管理超過1300億美元ETF資產，其中NEOS本身管理300億美元。交易完成後，高盛主動型ETF資產規模預計達到800億美元，並成為全球第8大主動型ETF管理業者。
NEOS所處的市場也正快速成長。高盛援引Morningstar資料指出，全球衍生品收益型ETF目前管理資產約1800億美元，自2021年以來年複合成長率超過70%，是ETF市場成長最快的類別之一。投資人對收益、稅務效率及下行風險管理的需求增加，正推動這類產品快速擴張。
就在宣布收購NEOS約6天後，高盛8月18日再宣布以最高4.1億美元收購商業房地產投資公司LCN Capital Partners，其中約2.6億美元將在交易完成時支付，另有最高1.5億美元與未來業績及服務承諾掛鉤。約80%的交易對價將以高盛股票支付，交易預計在2026年底完成。
LCN Capital成立於2011年，管理資產約30億美元，主要專注於售後回租及三淨租賃策略。這類交易通常由企業出售自有不動產後再租回使用，企業可以釋放房地產所占用的資本，而投資人則取得相對穩定的租金收入。
高盛收購LCN後，LCN共同創辦人Edward V. LaPuma及Bryan York Colwell以及旗下團隊將加入高盛資產管理部門的房地產平台。高盛認為，此次收購將擴大公司服務機構投資人、保險公司及財富管理客戶的能力，並進一步切入售後回租市場。
如果將這兩筆交易放在一起觀察，可以看到高盛資產管理策略的共同方向：一方面透過NEOS及Innovator擴大主動型ETF及選擇權策略產品，另一方面透過LCN擴大房地產及另類投資能力，藉此增加產品種類並擴大可收取管理費及相關費用的資產基礎。
這項策略也與高盛近年的業務轉型方向一致。相較於投資銀行、股票交易及固定收益交易等容易受到市場景氣影響的業務，資產與財富管理可以透過管理費、顧問費及其他相關收入建立較穩定的經常性營收來源。
高盛2026年第二季資產與財富管理部門淨營收達45.97億美元，較去年同期的約38.3億美元成長20%，較今年第1季的約40.7億美元增加13%。其中管理與其他費用收入達33.55億美元，創下紀錄，反映資產規模擴大已開始轉化為更高的經常性收入。
截至6月底，高盛資產與財富管理部門的資產監管規模(AUS)達4.041兆美元，較第1季的3.65兆美元增加3910億美元，也較2025年第二季的3.293兆美元增加7480億美元。這是高盛AUS首次突破4兆美元大關。
其中，另類投資AUS達4590億美元，高於第1季的4290億美元及去年同期的3710億美元；股票資產為1.123兆美元，固定收益資產為1.394兆美元，流動性產品則為1.065兆美元。
第二季高盛長期資產淨流入達910億美元，其中第三方分銷客戶渠道流入560億美元、財富管理客戶流入190億美元、機構客戶流入160億美元；包括流動性產品在內的總資產淨流入則達2300億美元，另有1610億美元來自市場升值。
另類投資也是高盛近年積極擴張的核心領域。第二季另類投資AUS單季增加300億美元，第三方另類投資募資更創下590億美元的單季紀錄。高盛簡報顯示，另類投資管理與其他費用收入第二季達7.25億美元，較去年同期成長22%。
高盛整體第二季業績同樣強勁。公司第二季淨營收達203.38億美元，淨利為66.28億美元，稀釋後每股盈餘(EPS)為20.98美元，年化股東權益報酬率(ROE)為23.5%。資產與財富管理業務的強勁表現，正成為整體業績的重要支柱。
高盛的策略並非只在於單純擴大資產管理規模，而是試圖建立從機構投資到高淨值客戶的完整產品生態。透過ETF、另類投資、私人市場、房地產及財富管理服務，公司可以將原本較複雜、過去主要由大型機構使用的投資策略，轉化為更容易銷售給高淨值個人及財富管理客戶的產品。
其中，私人市場尤其具有吸引力。高盛近年持續擴大私人股權、私人信貸、基礎建設及房地產等另類投資產品，並透過資產管理平台把機構級投資機會帶給更廣泛的財富管理客戶。
這種模式也能提高高盛與高淨值客戶之間的黏著度。當客戶同時使用ETF、另類投資、私人市場及財富管理服務時，高盛不僅能取得交易相關收入，也能透過管理費及其他服務建立較長期的收入來源。
從產業環境來看，資產管理業者目前也正面臨ETF快速成長、被動投資競爭及費率下降等壓力，因此大型金融機構開始積極收購具特色的ETF業者，以取得差異化產品及分銷能力。高盛接連收購Innovator與NEOS，正是這波產業整合的一部分。
同時，LCN交易則代表高盛並未把資產管理擴張限制在公開市場產品，而是同步向商業房地產及其他另類資產延伸。售後回租等策略能夠提供與通膨及實體資產相關的收益來源，也有助於高盛為機構與財富管理客戶提供更多元的資產配置工具。
因此，兩筆交易雖然分屬ETF與商業房地產，看似毫不相關，但背後其實指向同一項戰略：擴大高盛資產與財富管理平台的產品深度及資產規模，並將更多投資策略轉化為可持續收取費用的管理產品。
在第二季資產監管規模已達4.041兆美元、另類投資規模達4590億美元之際，高盛仍透過併購加速擴張。若NEOS與LCN交易最終順利完成，加上今年已完成的Innovator收購，高盛在ETF、另類投資及房地產等領域的版圖將進一步擴大，也意味著資產與財富管理業務可能在未來幾年扮演更加重要的角色。
對投資人而言，高盛近期的「買買買」並不只是追求規模，而是試圖建立更具經常性、可預測性的收入來源。在投資銀行與交易市場仍可能受到經濟周期及金融市場波動影響的情況下，能夠持續擴大管理資產並收取管理費的資產與財富管理業務，正逐漸成為高盛長期成長策略的重要支柱。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs Group (GS-US) has recently intensified its expansion of its asset and wealth management footprint, announcing the acquisition of ETF provider NEOS Investments and commercial real estate investment firm LCN Capital Partners within just six days, with a combined transaction value of about $2.66 billion. The two deals respectively target option‑strategy ETFs and the commercial real‑estate sale‑and‑leaseback market, underscoring Goldman’s continued investment of capital and resources into relatively stable, recurring management‑fee‑generating businesses.

On August 12, Goldman announced it would acquire NEOS Investments for up to $2.25 billion in cash and stock. NEOS, founded in 2022, currently manages about $30 billion in assets and offers 19 yield‑enhancing ETFs centered on option strategies, which use derivatives to boost returns, manage downside risk, and provide monthly income.

The transaction is expected to close in Q1 2027, with a maximum purchase price of $2.25 billion, the actual amount depending on NEOS meeting specific performance and service commitments. After closing, NEOS co‑founders Troy Cates and Garrett Paolella will join Goldman’s asset‑management division as partners, and the entire NEOS team is expected to join Goldman.

Goldman said NEOS is highly complementary to its existing business. The firm has already positioned itself in option‑based ETF strategies through its Innovator Capital Management platform, completing the acquisition of Innovator in April for about $2 billion. With NEOS on board, the two acquisitions will create a more complete option‑strategy ETF business alongside Goldman’s existing ETF platform.

Goldman noted that as of June 30 2026, the company, Innovator, and NEOS together manage over $130 billion in ETF assets, with NEOS alone managing $30 billion. After the deal, Goldman’s active‑ETF assets are projected to reach $80 billion, making it the world’s eighth‑largest active‑ETF manager.

NEOS operates in a rapidly growing market. Goldman cited Morningstar data showing that global derivative‑based yield ETFs manage about $180 billion in assets, with a compound annual growth rate of over 70% since 2021, making it one of the fastest‑growing ETF categories. Investor demand for yield, tax efficiency, and downside risk management is driving rapid expansion of these products.

Just six days after announcing the NEOS acquisition, Goldman announced on August 18 that it would acquire commercial real‑estate investment firm LCN Capital Partners for up to $410 million, with about $260 million payable at closing and up to $150 million tied to future performance and service commitments. Approximately 80% of the purchase price will be paid in Goldman shares, and the deal is expected to close by the end of 2026.

LCN Capital, founded in 2011, manages about $3 billion in assets and focuses on sale‑and‑leaseback and triple‑net lease strategies. These transactions typically involve a company selling its own real‑estate and then leasing it back, freeing capital for the company while investors receive relatively stable rental income.

After acquiring LCN, co‑founders Edward V. LaPuma and Bryan York Colwell, along with their team, will join Goldman’s asset‑management division’s real‑estate platform. Goldman believes this acquisition will expand its ability to serve institutional investors, insurance companies, and wealth‑management clients, and further penetrate the sale‑and‑leaseback market.

When viewed together, the two deals illustrate Goldman’s asset‑management strategy: on one hand, expanding active‑ETF and option‑strategy products through NEOS and Innovator; on the other, broadening real‑estate and alternative‑investment capabilities through LCN, thereby increasing product variety and expanding the asset base that generates management fees and related income.

This strategy aligns with Goldman’s recent business transformation. Compared to investment banking, equity trading, and fixed‑income trading—businesses vulnerable to market cycles—asset and wealth management can build more stable recurring revenue through management fees, advisory fees, and other related income.

Goldman’s second‑quarter 2026 asset‑and‑wealth‑management net revenue reached $4.597 billion, up 20% from about $3.83 billion a year earlier and 13% from about $4.07 billion in Q1, with management and other fee income hitting $3.355 billion, a record that reflects the growing asset base translating into higher recurring income.

As of the end of June, Goldman’s asset‑and‑wealth‑management AUS reached $4.041 trillion, up $391 billion from Q1’s $3.65 trillion and $748 billion from Q2 2025’s $3.293 trillion. This is the first time Goldman’s AUS has surpassed the $4 trillion threshold.

Within that, alternative‑investment AUS reached $459 billion, up from $429 billion in Q1 and $371 billion a year earlier; equity assets were $1.123 trillion, fixed‑income assets $1.394 trillion, and liquidity products $1.065 trillion.

In Q2, Goldman’s long‑term asset net inflow was $91 billion, with $56 billion from third‑party distribution channels, $19 billion from wealth‑management clients, and $16 billion from institutional clients; total asset net inflow, including liquidity products, reached $230 billion, with an additional $161 billion from market appreciation.

Alternative investments are also a core area of Goldman’s recent expansion. Q2 alternative‑investment AUS grew by $30 billion, with third‑party alternative‑investment fundraising setting a new quarterly record of $59 billion. Goldman’s presentation showed alternative‑investment management and other fee income reached $725 million in Q2, up 22% from a year earlier.

Goldman’s overall Q2 performance was strong. The company’s Q2 net revenue was $20.338 billion, net income $6.628 billion, diluted EPS $20.98, and annualized ROE 23.5%. The robust asset‑and‑wealth‑management business is becoming a key pillar of overall performance.

Goldman’s strategy is not merely to expand asset‑management scale, but to build a complete product ecosystem from institutional investors to high‑net‑worth clients. Through ETFs, alternative investments, private markets, real‑estate, and wealth‑management services, the firm can transform complex, previously institution‑centric strategies into products that are easier to sell to high‑net‑worth individuals and wealth‑management clients.

Private markets are particularly attractive. Goldman has continued to expand private‑equity, private‑credit, infrastructure, and real‑estate alternative‑investment products, and uses its asset‑management platform to bring institutional‑level opportunities to a broader wealth‑management client base.

This model also increases Goldman’s stickiness with high‑net‑worth clients. When clients use ETFs, alternative investments, private markets, and wealth‑management services simultaneously, Goldman not only earns transaction revenue but also builds longer‑term income through management fees and other services.

From an industry perspective, asset‑management firms face rapid ETF growth, passive‑investment competition, and fee‑pressure, prompting large financial institutions to acquire distinctive ETF firms to gain differentiated products and distribution capabilities. Goldman’s successive acquisitions of Innovator and NEOS are part of this industry consolidation wave.

Meanwhile, the LCN deal signals that Goldman is not limiting its asset‑management expansion to public‑market products, but also extending into commercial real‑estate and other alternative assets. Sale‑and‑leaseback strategies provide inflation‑linked and tangible‑asset‑related income streams, helping Goldman offer more diversified allocation tools to institutional and wealth‑management clients.

Thus, although the two deals belong to ETFs and commercial real‑estate and appear unrelated, they ultimately point to the same strategy: expanding Goldman’s asset‑and‑wealth‑management platform’s product depth and asset scale, and converting more investment strategies into sustainable fee‑generating products.

With AUS at $4.041 trillion and alternative‑investment AUS at $459 billion in Q2, Goldman continues to accelerate growth through acquisitions. If the NEOS and LCN deals close successfully, combined with the already completed Innovator acquisition, Goldman’s footprint in ETFs, alternative investments, and real‑estate will expand further, implying that asset‑and‑wealth‑management could play an even more important role in the coming years.

For investors, Goldman’s recent “buy‑buy‑buy” is not just about scale but about building more recurring, predictable income. While investment banking and trading markets may still be affected by economic cycles and market volatility, the ability to continuously grow assets under management and collect management fees is gradually becoming a key pillar of Goldman’s long‑term growth strategy.

items.title: AI撐住市場卻掩蓋風險？瑞銀CEO：金融市場「自滿」已久 投資人最好別押太大
items.title_en: AI Supports the Market but Masks Risks? UBS CEO: Financial Markets Have Been Complacent for a Long Time – Investors Shouldn’t Bet Too Big
paras: 瑞銀集團 (UBS-US) 執行長Ermotti週四(10日)警告，儘管地緣政治與經濟風險持續升高，過去幾年金融市場卻出現投資人過度自滿的現象。他指出，以目前面臨的風險環境來看，市場原本應該出現更大幅度的波動，但人工智慧、資料中心及其他新科技的大量投資，持續支撐經濟成長與金融市場表現。
Ermotti接受CNBC訪問時表示，過去幾年金融市場存在一定程度的「自滿」，市場雖然偶爾出現劇烈震盪，但整體波動程度仍低於當前複雜風險環境所應有的水準。
他表示，目前市場面臨的問題並非單一事件，而是多項風險同時存在，而且新的問題不斷出現，過去的問題卻沒有真正獲得解決。他指出，伊朗與烏克蘭戰爭所引發的能源與航運風險、美中競爭對供應鏈造成的壓力，以及借貸成本上升與通膨頑強等因素，都正在對全球經濟形成多重逆風。
近期中東局勢再度推升能源價格，布蘭特原油價格已重新站上每桶100美元，並帶動全球債券殖利率走高。路透報導指出，美國10年期公債殖利率近期升至約4.84%，接近2023年以來高位，市場對能源成本升高可能重新推升通膨的疑慮也隨之升溫。
Ermotti認為，在這種環境下，投資人不宜對單一市場、資產或方向抱持過度強烈的看法。「在這樣的環境中很難做出強烈判斷，也不太適合持有太多強烈的投資信念。」他表示，全球最富有的投資人近期正透過擴大產業與地域配置來降低不確定性，而不是押注單一市場的大方向。
UBS客戶近幾季確實增加跨產業及跨地域配置，同時仍持續投資人工智慧與科技領域。不過，Ermotti表示，整體而言，UBS客戶過去一年資產配置並未出現重大改變，增加分散投資也不代表投資人正在大規模撤離美國資產。
